scientific_integrity: Originality assessment applies to the two sharp optimization transitions and their comparison; the model, full first-passage transform and mean threshold are explicitly credited to prior authors. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Finite-interval, symmetric-start one-dimensional telegraph particle with exponential wall release, no extra diffusion or partial exit; second-moment optimality is not tail stochastic dominance. General exit-time transform is prior work and gives an implicit-priority risk.
title: Two distinct optimal-tumbling transitions for mean and variance of confined active escape
